description: Providing relief to fifteen employees of Kabool Lanka (Pvt) Ltd, Thulhiriya and to the employees at the Thulhiriya and Pugoda textile mills that were under the National Textile Corporation, who have lost their jobs and have not yet received compensation
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-11-24 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - Measures have been taken to pay compensation and other statutory allowances to the employees who were aggrieved by the closure of Kabool Lanka (Pvt) Ltd, Thulhiriya, and 15 other employees who have not received such compensation have made requests for their compensation entitlements. Further, as per the approval granted at the Cabinet meeting held on 2025‑06‑13 for the payment of compensation for the employees who lost their jobs in 1978, having served in Thulhiriya and Pugoda textile mills that were under the National Textile Corporation, 1,656 employees have been compensated as of now. Another 169 employees who did not appear at the initial stage have now submitted their applications. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Labour to pay compensation and other statutory entitlements to the 15 employees of Kabool Lanka (Pvt) Ltd, Thulhiriya, and to make payments to another 169 employees who lost their jobs having served in the Thulhiriya and Pugoda Textile Mills, was approved by the Cabinet.
